accepted.sentence: During an engine tune-up, a mechanic removes spark plugs for inspection and fits replacements without damaging their threaded shells.
When replacing worn suspension links, technicians loosen the sway-bar nuts while leaving the vehicle's steering alignment undisturbed.
On a bicycle wheel, turning spoke nipples changes spoke tension and can correct a rim that wobbles from side to side.
A technician tightens a microphone stand's clamp fastener to keep its extended boom from slipping during a performance.
During rooftop heating and cooling maintenance, workers secure access-panel fasteners before returning the unit to operation.
At a printing plant, maintenance workers tighten roller-bearing locknuts to keep press components in their intended positions.
During brake service, technicians loosen caliper mounting fasteners so the caliper can be moved aside to replace worn pads.
When adjusting a trailer's wheel bearing, a mechanic turns the spindle nut to set bearing play before securing it with a retainer.
